title: Single Metal-1 Rectangular Contact Pad
description: DRC-clean ASCII GDSII stream defining a Metal-1 interconnect landing pad with centered contact cut and pin label on a 1 nm database grid.
code:
# GDSII ASCII Stream: DRC-Clean Metal-1 Contact Landing Pad
HEADER 600
BGNLIB
LIBNAME CONTACT_PAD_LIB
UNITS 1e-3 1e-9

BGNSTR
STRNAME M1_CONTACT_PAD
  BOUNDARY
  LAYER 5
  DATATYPE 0
  XY 0: 0  600: 0  600: 600  0: 600  0: 0
  ENDEL
  BOUNDARY
  LAYER 4
  DATATYPE 0
  XY 180: 180  420: 180  420: 420  180: 420  180: 180
  ENDEL
  TEXT
  LAYER 5
  TEXTTYPE 0
  XY 300: 300
  STRING "PAD_A"
  ENDEL
ENDSTR
ENDLIB

title: 6T SRAM Bitcell Layout with Symmetry
description: Symmetric 6-transistor static RAM bitcell in ASCII GDSII using mirrored SREF half-cell instantiation (STRANS reflection), cross-coupled poly gates, and AREF bitline contact arrays.
code:
# GDSII ASCII Stream: Symmetric 6T SRAM Bitcell with SREF Mirroring & AREF Contacts
HEADER 600
BGNLIB
LIBNAME SRAM_6T_LIB
UNITS 1e-3 1e-9

BGNSTR
STRNAME BIT_CONTACT
  BOUNDARY
  LAYER 4
  DATATYPE 0
  XY 0: 0  240: 0  240: 240  0: 240  0: 0
  ENDEL
ENDSTR

BGNSTR
STRNAME SRAM_HALF
  # Half-cell Active Diffusion
  BOUNDARY
  LAYER 2
  DATATYPE 0
  XY 200: 400  1600: 400  1600: 1100  200: 1100  200: 400
  ENDEL
  # Cross-coupled Inverter Poly Gate
  BOUNDARY
  LAYER 3
  DATATYPE 0
  XY 750: 200  1050: 200  1050: 1400  750: 1400  750: 200
  ENDEL
  # Array of 2 Source/Drain Contacts
  AREF
  SNAME BIT_CONTACT
  COLROW 2 1
  XY 350: 630  1950: 630  350: 1230
  ENDEL
ENDSTR

BGNSTR
STRNAME SRAM_6T_BITCELL
  # Shared Center N-Well
  BOUNDARY
  LAYER 1
  DATATYPE 0
  XY 0: 1500  4200: 1500  4200: 3100  0: 3100  0: 1500
  ENDEL
  # Left Half-Cell
  SREF
  SNAME SRAM_HALF
  XY 200: 200
  ENDEL
  # Mirrored Right Half-Cell
  SREF
  SNAME SRAM_HALF
  STRANS 1000000000000000
  MAG 1.0
  ANGLE 0.0
  XY 2200: 3000
  ENDEL
  # Wordline (Metal-1)
  PATH
  LAYER 5
  DATATYPE 0
  PATHTYPE 2
  WIDTH 320
  XY 0: 3400  4200: 3400
  ENDEL
  # Bitline BL and BLB (Metal-2, Layer 7)
  PATH
  LAYER 7
  DATATYPE 0
  PATHTYPE 2
  WIDTH 360
  XY 500: 0  500: 3600
  ENDEL
  PATH
  LAYER 7
  DATATYPE 0
  PATHTYPE 2
  WIDTH 360
  XY 3700: 0  3700: 3600
  ENDEL
  TEXT
  LAYER 5
  TEXTTYPE 0
  XY 2100: 3400
  STRING "WL"
  ENDEL
  TEXT
  LAYER 7
  TEXTTYPE 0
  XY 500: 1800
  STRING "BL"
  ENDEL
  TEXT
  LAYER 7
  TEXTTYPE 0
  XY 3700: 1800
  STRING "BLB"
  ENDEL
ENDSTR
ENDLIB
